title: On tail behavior of infinite sums of independent indicators
summary: Let $Y=\sum_{k\ge 1} 1_{A_k}$ be an infinite sum of the indicators of independent events. We investigate a precise (as opposed to logarithmic) first-order asymptotic behavior of the tail probabilities $\mathbb{P}\{Y\ge n\}$ and the point probabilities $\mathbb{P}\{Y=n\}$ as $n\to\infty$. Our analysis provides a reasonably complete classification of the asymptotic behaviors covering most cases of practical interest.
